metrics_destination: module-level ENGINEERING_METRICS populated only when root supervised worker executes F10-28

static_review.mode: full source and direct caller read only; no imports, compilation or candidate execution

findings.finding: Visit state differs from frozen F10-02: production and reference emit reclaim; expected state is reclaimed. Use explicit event-to-state conversion in both independent implementations.

_refresh_hot calls active_set after every commit; _views enumerates and decodes every historical birth, including archived objects. active/relation capacity queries scan full records each commit; restore repeats full _views for each suffix batch. Replace with bounded current projections and targeted hot updates; separately count all SQL/index/decode work.

events_asof, visits_asof and _visit_heads materialize unbounded history. Observation admission scans every old visit merely to find open visit/next ordinal. relations_asof materializes global relations before object filtering. Add bounded pagination and object-local current visit/relation indexes; preserve named fixture API behavior within bounds.

TTL archive excludes hot IDs but capacity counts still treat expired-by-TTL births as active forever. Relation capacity retains all non-tombstoned inactive history. Use frozen lifetime policy for hot capacity, retain durable history, and prevent visits/fallback on TTL-expired or invalid-instrument objects.

Ancestry RelationVersion changes ancestry table only; it adds no reverse dependencies or support gating. Parent invalidation through relation-only edges does not reach child. Include current relation ancestry in support/dirty propagation; tombstone must update affected projection without altering historical cuts.

Mapping evidence may be omitted from evidence_versions and dependencies; it is not required to be latest, so mapping correction may never gate mapped object. Anchor evidence instrument is not checked; cross-instrument parent mapping checks only mapping existence, not exact parent source. Validate full mapping/source/anchor instrument closure and include mapping source dependencies.

PublicationClock accepts completion before decision_cut. Object/anchor/observation dependencies are checked against final publication rather than frozen input cut; past declared known_at can conceal later effective batch publication. Define staged earlier-member exception explicitly, check prior-row effective known time and required inputs against decision/input clocks; reject future event facts where inappropriate.

Observation admission uses any old observed evidence version without checking latest support, evidence_state, instrument validity or TTL. Unknown-order ENTER/CONTACT can open a visit, and unknown distinct timestamp ordering is accepted without clear source evidence policy. Validate event support and preserve unknown chronology explicitly.

fallback(previous_valid) calls _support against latest entire database for historical cut, causing future correction leakage. It ignores TTL, evidence_state and terminal expired/superseded birth restrictions and can return current version as prior fallback. Use as-of support and explicit valid prior policy/provenance.

Checkpoint/audit validate saved payloads but omit births, dependencies, ancestry, record metadata known/sequence/identity/ordinal, state known/sequence metadata, extra injected rows and control metadata. Tampering can pass and change queries or next updates. Journal must be authority: fully verify/rebuild all derived indexes with measured integrity work and exact-prefix binding.

lineage_payload uses separate read transactions, so concurrent commit can mix cursors. Instrument filter affects objects only; observations/visits/relations/targets/actions remain global. candidate_cut may be future or mismatched instrument/cursor. Build one snapshot at one cursor, validate cut compatibility and complete instrument-specific closure; distinguish requested cut from actual known publication.

Canonical source origins are only required to be a subset of closure and remain caller ordered. Empty/subset/reordered origins can produce multiple birth identities for same formation. Normalize unordered origin IDs and enforce the intended complete origin closure while preserving declared anchor order; account for parent source closure in split/merge fixtures.

RegistryDefinition permits terminal initial states and arbitrary tuple ordering/duplicate generator IDs with different versions; semantic version is separate hash while id can remain same. Clarify frozen definition identity and reject impossible birth lifecycle configurations.

Production implicit parent_versions ancestry is not exposed by relations_asof or candidate relation closure. Freeze only captures relations incident to current latest versions, omitting parent/anchor/evidence/transitive original versions. Preserve full exact candidate lineage closure, including archived intermediate ancestors, without conflating display and ancestry.

Control APIs return mutable nested dict/list values despite immutable public-record contract. Values are detached from durable storage but public immutability is not enforced. Return deeply immutable mappings/tuples or canonical bytes consistently.

Reference ignores reset_on_geometry_change configuration; it shares missing mapping/relation support behavior. assert_parity compares objects, state, visits, relations, cuts and targets but never action groups or all version membership. Add independent config-aware fold and full closure comparisons.

Coverage gaps against frozen literals: F10-03 lacks saved uninterrupted baseline; F10-04 lacks explicit post-rejection all-table absence; F10-21 uses preset labels but no immutable ratio/config provenance; F10-24/25 omit explicit uncertified mapping/replay assertions; F10-29 corrupt checkpoint fields without recomputed checksum, does not duplicate suffix B3 or assert zero prefix derivation; F10-31 lacks explicit two unfrozen equal-time cursor assertions. Other expected boolean fields are implicit/hardcoded rather than mapped exact assertions. Expand existing 34 methods with every frozen expected field and complete failure/no-mutation checks.

F10-28 saves pre-update telemetry under incremental_telemetry_before_restore, so no after/delta adjacency/read costs retained. query_parity includes full reference construction and all queries, not isolated indexed query time; restore telemetry contaminated by assert_parity; object_evaluations excludes admission/support recursion and full hot scans. Capture before/after deltas, raw exact operation counts, isolated query/restore and named retained IO/decode costs; no speedup claim.

Source correction batch dirty propagation can create more derived payload than allowed; atomic rejection is correct but no resumable bounded dirty closure exists. Keep explicit capacity_unavailable gate and document that finite limits bound total accepted closure rather than claiming arbitrary targeted scaling.

verify.py labels legacy objects group with F10.LINEAGE even though it only loads tests.test_objects; new object-lineage group is correct. Parent should remove lineage certification from legacy-only owner mapping or label declaration versus executed coverage explicitly.
